text:
rachel: Noticed inconsistent SDK examples: streaming in Python shows resume_token + streaming loop, but TS and Go still show single-shot create(). Can we align before tomorrow's docs release?

sam: Thanks — which files?

rachel: guide/streaming.md and reference/pagination.md. Python was updated in PR 4620 but others weren't.

theo: I can update TS to an async-iterator streaming example. Will also add a one-liner about resumeToken vs resending prompts.

priya: I'll take Go; current Go snippet uses Create() once and the List() example doesn't show Retry-After handling. I'll add cursor loop + minimal backoff.

rachel: Copy of Python snippet: `resp = client.responses.create(..., stream=True, resume_token=last_token)
for ev in resp:
  if ev.type=="delta": print(ev.delta, end='')`

theo: Proposed TS: `const s = await client.responses.stream({model:'rwd-4x', input:prompt, resumeToken: lastToken}); for await (const e of s) { if (e.type==='delta') process.stdout.write(e.delta ?? '') }`

priya: Go sketch: `cursor := ""; for { res, err := client.Responses.List(ctx, ListOpts{Cursor:cursor}); if err != nil { sleep(backoff.Next()); continue }; for _,it := range res.Items { fmt.Println(it.Text) }; if res.NextCursor=="" { break }; cursor = res.NextCursor }` (also show checking Retry-After header).

docs-bot: Checklist: 1) TS async iterator, 2) Go cursor+retry, 3) short resume note per language, 4) add mocked smoke tests under /examples/smoke/ to run in docs CI.

theo: I'll open PR 4651 for TS and add smoke test mocked harness.

priya: Opening PR 4652 for Go.

rachel: I'll add a tiny cross-ref between streaming.md and pagination.md and mention idiomatic names (`resume_token`/`resumeToken`/`ResumeToken`).

docs-bot: Automated check: PR 4620 merged; PRs 4651/4652 pending. Please add `ci: docs-smoke` label to trigger smoke job.

theo: PR 4651 -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4651 (linted, smoke mocked pass).

priya: PR 4652 -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4652 (added Retry-After handling).

rachel: Quick review left; planning to merge both before the release cut. Thanks all.
